page.overview:
Who is Drift?

Drift is a master of ancient weaponry who always remains calm and controlled during combat. Long ago, he fought for the Decepticons. The scars of battle changed his thinking, and now Drift wields his swords for good as a member of the Autobots.

Drift is kind, caring, selfless, serious, intelligent, calculating and wise, he has a sense of justice, honor and good morals, on the battlefield, he is a great fighter and tactician, he is respectful towards those were rightfully earned his respect like, Optimus Prime, the latter who he refers to as sensei, however, he has no respect for Bumblebee due to his immaturity and lack of discipline.

Drift is very mature, calm, level-headed, discipline and patient.

Drift is an Autobot swordsman using fighting styles similar to that of Circuit-Su and Metallikato. He is a Triple Changer, transforming into a Bugatti Veyron and a Helicopter. Though he previously fought for tyrannical Megatron and his Decepticons, he is now fiercely loyal to his "Sensei".
